summary.intent: Execute Phase 45, Wave 1 of a multi-phase refactoring effort, specifically completing plan 45-01 (characterization tests) and starting plan 45-02 (extracting shared journal-dir and max-retries helpers in the desktop app).
summary.outcome: Plan 45-01 was completed successfully with 6 characterization tests all passing and 3 commits on the correct branch. Plan 45-02 was initiated by spawning an agent to execute it.

repo: The project uses a phased, wave-based planning structure (e.g., Phase 45, Wave 1/5, Plan 45-02 of 6) for large refactoring efforts.
Dead-code warnings in `fuse_abi.rs` are pre-existing in the vendored `fuser` ABI file and are unrelated to active changes — should not be treated as regressions.
Checkpointing convention uses bracketed markers like `[checkpoint] phase 45 wave 1/5 plan 45-01 complete` to track progress across plans.

code.finding: Contains pre-existing dead-code warnings from the vendored `fuser` ABI; these are not introduced by current changes and can be safely ignored.

workflow: Spot-checking branch state (SUMMARY + commit count) after completing a plan before moving to the next is a used verification step.
Characterization tests are used as a completion gate for refactoring plans before proceeding to extraction work.
Agent tool is used to execute individual plans within a wave, allowing parallel or delegated execution of discrete plan units.

friction: Dead-code warnings from vendored code (`fuse_abi.rs`) required explicit acknowledgment to distinguish from newly introduced issues.
open_items: Plans 45-02 through 45-06 (5 of 6 plans in Wave 1) remain to be completed.
Waves 2–5 of Phase 45 have not yet started.
Plan 45-02 (extract shared journal-dir + max-retries helper in desktop app) was in-flight at transcript end — outcome not yet known.
